absolute_deadlines.failure: STOP on missing/expired time or failed cleanup; no retry/budget expansion.

acceptance: Only the exact new run with R2 contract/source identities, verified non-root checkout owner/full source identity, one metadata/check attempt and confirmed invocation each, preserved bounded diagnostics, complete unchanged canonical input summary, cleanup completed, and complete measured child CPU within180 can qualify as a new measurement. Worker STOP cannot be accepted by supervisor as a valid measurement. It never proves historical CI causality or whole-job cost completeness.

admission_gaps: Existing runner systemd/passwordless sudo/cgroup controller behavior has not been executed or qualified; failed gate must STOP before acquisition.

Any future admitted acquisition uses only the unchanged locked HTTPS URL without credentials, and failure stops before check.

Registry/artifact network transfer and cold-cache runtime are unmeasured. The finite limits can produce a STOP and never auto-expand or retry.
Whole-job host/checkout/upload/manager/teardown CPU and remote service/network costs are unmeasured and remain null.
